title: Database Foundation
description: Establish the global database layer with Kysely, complete type definitions, and a single migration creating all tables.
acceptance_criteria: DatabaseModule is decorated with @Global() and exports DatabaseService
DatabaseService extends Kysely<Database> and connects using process.env.DATABASE_URL
types.ts defines Database interface including organizations, users, projects, tasks tables
Every table interface includes tenant_id: string (organizations uses its own id as tenant_id)
Generated<> is used ONLY on id, created_at, updated_at, is_active columns
001_initial.ts creates organizations, users, projects, tasks tables with all columns, CHECK constraints, FKs, ON DELETE rules, UNIQUE constraints, and indexes exactly as specified
users.role CHECK constraint allows only 'Admin','ProjectManager','Member'
projects.status CHECK constraint allows only 'Active','Archived'
tasks.status CHECK constraint allows only 'ToDo','InProgress','Completed'
UNIQUE(name, tenant_id) constraint exists on projects table
migrate.ts executes all pending migrations on application bootstrap
app.module.ts imports DatabaseModule

title: Authentication Module
description: Implement JWT-based authentication with registration, login, refresh tokens, global guard, and role decorators.
acceptance_criteria: AuthController exposes POST /api/auth/register with @Public() decorator
POST /api/auth/register requires query param organization_id and body { email, password, first_name, last_name }
RegisterDto validates email as @IsEmail() max 255, password min 8 max 100, first_name and last_name min 1 max 100
Role is NEVER accepted from body and is hardcoded to 'Member'
Password is hashed with bcrypt using 12 salt rounds
Registration returns 201 with { id, email, first_name, last_name, role, tenant_id, created_at }
POST /api/auth/login is @Public() and accepts { email, password }
Successful login returns { access_token, refresh_token, user: { id, email, role, tenant_id } }
Access token expires in 15m and refresh token expires in 7d
POST /api/auth/refresh is @Public() and accepts { refresh_token } returning { access_token }
jwt.strategy.ts validate() returns { id, email, role, tenant_id } mapped from payload.sub
Global JWT guard is registered using APP_GUARD in app.module.ts
RolesGuard reads metadata from @Roles() decorator and enforces exact role match
Controllers have NO @UseGuards() decorator
Rate limiting is configured globally to 100 requests per minute per IP
app.module.ts imports AuthModule

title: Organizations Module
description: Allow creation of an organization with its first Admin user and return an access token.
acceptance_criteria: OrganizationsController exposes POST /api/organizations with @Public() decorator
CreateOrganizationDto includes name, admin_email, admin_password, admin_first_name, admin_last_name with proper validation
Creating organization inserts into organizations table and creates first user with role 'Admin'
Admin password is hashed with bcrypt 12 rounds
Endpoint returns 201 with { access_token, organization: { id, name, created_at }, admin: { id, email, role, tenant_id } }
Organization name is unique and conflicts return 409
All inserts correctly set tenant_id equal to organization id
Controller has NO @UseGuards() decorator
app.module.ts imports OrganizationsModule

title: Users Module
description: Provide tenant-scoped user listing restricted to Admin role.
acceptance_criteria: UsersController exposes GET /api/users
GET /api/users requires @Roles('Admin')
GET /api/users implements pagination with query ?page=&limit=
Response shape is { data: User[], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
Each query filters strictly with .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
Returned fields are id, email, first_name, last_name, role, created_at
Non-Admin users receive 403 Forbidden
Controller has NO @UseGuards() decorator
app.module.ts imports UsersModule

title: Projects Module
description: Enable creation and listing of tenant-scoped projects with role restrictions.
acceptance_criteria: ProjectsController exposes POST /api/projects
POST /api/projects requires @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')
CreateProjectDto validates name min 1 max 255, optional description max 1000, status @IsIn(['Active','Archived'])
Project name must be unique per tenant else 409 Conflict
Insert sets tenant_id from req.user.tenant_id
POST /api/projects returns 201 with { id, name, description, status, tenant_id, created_at }
ProjectsController exposes GET /api/projects
GET /api/projects is accessible to any authenticated user
GET /api/projects implements pagination standard response shape
All queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
Controller has NO @UseGuards() decorator
app.module.ts imports ProjectsModule

title: Tasks Module
description: Provide full tenant-scoped task creation and listing with ownership and role enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: TasksController exposes POST /api/tasks
POST /api/tasks requires @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager','Member')
CreateTaskDto validates project_id as UUID, title min 1 max 255, optional description max 2000, status @IsIn(['ToDo','InProgress','Completed']), optional assignee_id UUID
Project must exist with matching tenant_id else 404
If assignee_id provided it must exist in same tenant else 404
If role is 'Member' and assignee_id is provided and not equal to req.user.id then throw ForbiddenException
Insert sets tenant_id from req.user.tenant_id
POST /api/tasks returns 201 with { id, project_id, title, description, status, assignee_id, tenant_id, created_at }
TasksController exposes GET /api/tasks
GET /api/tasks implements pagination standard response shape
All SELECT queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
Controller has NO @UseGuards() decorator
app.module.ts imports TasksModule

title: Dashboard and Notifications Module
description: Provide aggregated tenant dashboard statistics and basic task assignment notifications.
acceptance_criteria: DashboardController exposes GET /api/dashboard/summary
GET /api/dashboard/summary returns { total_users, total_projects, total_tasks, tasks_by_status: { ToDo, InProgress, Completed } }
All dashboard queries filter by tenant_id = req.user.tenant_id
NotificationsController exposes GET /api/notifications
GET /api/notifications returns paginated list of tasks assigned to req.user.id with standard pagination response shape
Notification query filters by tenant_id and assignee_id = req.user.id
Controllers have NO @UseGuards() decorator
app.module.ts imports DashboardModule and NotificationsModule

title: Audit Logs Module
description: Record and expose tenant-scoped audit logs for critical actions.
acceptance_criteria: Audit logs table is added to types.ts and 001_initial.ts with columns id, action, entity, entity_id, user_id, tenant_id, created_at
Audit logs table includes INDEX(tenant_id) and INDEX(user_id)
AuditService provides method logAction(action, entity, entity_id, user_id, tenant_id)
AuditController exposes GET /api/audit-logs
GET /api/audit-logs requires @Roles('Admin')
GET /api/audit-logs implements pagination standard response shape
All SELECT queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
Controller has NO @UseGuards() decorator
app.module.ts imports AuditModule
